articles.title: Is a Manual Treadmill Worth the Extra Effort?
articles.summary: You’re at the gym facing a line of treadmills . Most are your standard running machine with an electric motor and a flat deck. But there are also a few odd looking machines that arch up in the front and the back, with no buttons on the console and no plug for an outlet. Meet the manual treadmill, also called a self-powered or non-motorized treadmill. articles.title: Philippine Protests Grow as Government Welcomes Trump
articles.summary: When Donald Trump landed in Manila on Tuesday for the first stop of his trip to Asia this week , the Philippine government rolled out the red carpet for the ally leader. But elsewhere in the Southeast Asian nation, the U.S. President’s welcome wasn’t so warm. In the lead-up to Trump’s visit, activists, students, and members of the local indigenous community clashed with Philippine law enforcement in the capital, where the 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit is being hosted, and in Cebu . articles.title: The Greenland Test: What Follows When America Coerces Its Allies
articles.summary: President Donald Trump began his second term in office by weaponizing European worries about being abandoned by the United States, attacking NATO , and threatening to annex or buy Greenland , the semi-autonomous territory of the Kingdom of Denmark. On Sept. 22, Trump got much of what he wanted, short of sovereignty. He signed an agreement with Denmark and Greenland on the future of U.S. presence on the island. articles.title: Congressman Says U.S. Gets Threats ‘Quite Often’ Amid Reports of Iran Plotting ‘Dirty Bomb’
articles.summary: Iran is reportedly developing potential plans to detonate a “dirty bomb” in Washington, D.C., a threat that one member of the House Intelligence Committee called an intimidation tactic. Citing seven U.S. officials, CNN reported on Monday that new U.S. intelligence indicates planning by Iran to target Trump Administration officials in an attack on the capital. articles.title: United Airlines Experiences Temporary System Outage in the Wake of Nationwide Ground Stop
articles.summary: United Airlines has resolved a technology issue that delayed departing flights on Monday afternoon, three days after the Federal Aviation Administration issued a nationwide ground stop that has continued to impact flights around the country. United Airlines confirmed in a statement to TIME on Monday evening that there was a “technology issue that delayed flight departures” that had since been resolved.
